about: BBC (www.bbc.com): read BBC News and Sport from the command line. Covers article, video and live-blog details, section, region and topic listings, live pages, football scores, fixtures, tables and team lookup, the BBC News TV schedule, JSON page content and video media streams.

commands.summary: List the latest stories (articles, videos, live pages) on a top-level BBC section page such as news, sport, business or technology.

params.name: section
params.description: Top-level section slug, e.g. news (homepage top stories), sport, business, innovation, culture, arts, travel, technology

commands.summary: List the latest stories on a BBC sub-section page, e.g. technology/artificial-intelligence.

params.name: section
params.description: Parent section slug, e.g. technology, business, culture

commands.summary: List the latest BBC News stories for a world region (Europe, Asia, Africa, ...).
List stories tagged with a BBC News topic (e.g. France), paginated.
Get a BBC News article's metadata: headline, description, author, publish/modify dates, image.
Get a BBC News video page: title, description, publish time and related video links.
Get a BBC live blog page: title, description and latest update time.
List the BBC live blogs currently running (news and sport), from the /live index.
List football matches (scores and fixtures, all competitions) on a given date.
List a football team's recent results and upcoming fixtures.

params.name: team
params.description: Team slug (from search-football-teams URLs), e.g. arsenal, arsenal-ladies

commands.summary: Get the current standings table for a football competition.

params.name: competition
params.description: Competition slug, e.g. premier-league, championship, scottish-premiership

commands.summary: Find football teams and competitions by name. Returns BBC URNs and scores-fixtures URLs (the team slug is in the URL).
List the BBC News TV channel programme schedule (titles, synopses, start times) for a country feed.

params.name: country
params.description: Two-letter country code of the schedule feed

commands.summary: Get structured JSON content for a BBC page path (e.g. a /reel/video/{id}/watch video): title, summary, publish times, metadata.
Resolve a BBC media PID into playable stream URLs (HLS video renditions and thumbnails).

params.name: pid
params.description: BBC programme/clip PID, e.g. p0ph9dhb (found in video page data)
